scope: I08 ADX/DMI-only standalone research. No live/ladder/short changes or indicator/HL/SR combinations.
formula: Wilder means of TR,+DM,-DM over N changes starting bar1, SMA seed N observations then (previous*(N-1)+x)/N. TR=max(high-low,abs(high-prevClose),abs(low-prevClose)). up=high-prevHigh; down=prevLow-low; +DM=up if up>0 and up>down else0; -DM=down if down>0 and down>up else0. Equal moves excluded. DI=100*DMmean/TRmean (zeroTR=>both0), DX=100*abs(plus-minus)/(plus+minus) (zero sum=>0), ADX=Wilder mean N DX starting indexN, first valid2N-1. DI valid indexN. No rounding, recursive seed fixed, gaps rejected. ADX/DI lengths tied N7/14/28, no independent smoothing grid. Period14 must match prior accepted shared features exactly.

entryRules.di_cross: Fresh DI spread zero crossing: long previous<=0,current>0; short previous>=0,current<0. ADX need not be available.
entryRules.di_strong: Same fresh DI crossing AND current ADX>=threshold20/25/40. No later catch-up entry after a failed strength gate; unfiltered same-period/side/exit DI cross retained as control.
entryRules.adx_cross: Previous ADX<=threshold,current>threshold20/25/40 AND current DI spread has entry-side sign. Strength rising through threshold, not persistent state.
entryRules.adx_peak_fade: Three fully closed ADX observations: older<=previous,current<previous, previous>=threshold40/50, current DI spread opposite entry side. Fade still-dominant direction only after known ADX downturn; not an inferred future pivot or proof of reversal.

exitRules: Fixed12h from actual fill or earliest subsequent DI condition capped at12h. Continuation modes long spread<=0,short>=0; peak_fade long spread>=0,short<=0. Timeout wins ties; no same-entry observation exit; immutable pending; no ADX falling exit.
timing: Contiguous finalized selected-timeframe bars; next minute-open, modeled0 publication lag or separate+1m every entry and exit. Full fixed seed; no execution-minute H/L/C at decision, no future bar or sliding reseed.
inventory: One independent $10k position; no compounding/averaging. Occupied/pending crossings skipped, fresh signal after exit. Open cutoff inventory marked including hypothetical close fee; not counted as completed.
funding: Excluded due incomplete settlement evidence. After trading fees before funding; no liquidation/shared-account/queue/live fills certification.
researchScreen: Same inherited screen: >=30full/10recent closes in both delays, positive net and own-side clock delta allfour; no monthly marked delta below-1e-8; positive extra5bps/side and no equity exhaustion.
ranking: All540 by full0m delta versus own-side clock, also absolute net per side. Descriptive sample/net/stress/solvent subset allfour cases, rank full0m absolute net; top5 if available else rawtop5, failures retained. No relaxed deployment gate.
reporting: Baselines alongside W/L counts/dollars, net/open/DD; full/recent periods, monthly top5 and rawtop5, both delays/cost stress, all540 definitions, own-entry12h exit deltas, worst paths/winner concentration. If subset<5 retain actual subset size, do not pad with failures. For di_strong report same-side/timeframe/period/exit unfiltered DI-cross companion and independent delta checks.
overlapParity: 8 exact old/new/saved I01 clock cases before outcomes. No previously tested standalone DMI definitions. Period14 numeric overlap against shared accepted feature module on actual data and fixtures.
limitations: 540 correlated previously-mined definitions; full/recent overlap, no holdout. Not independent ADX smoothing periods, daily, DI magnitude/ADX slope levels, rising-only filter, low-strength fade, price stops/targets/trailing/partials, additional indicators/HL/SR, ladder/shared account. Falling ADX is unsigned trend weakening, not a guaranteed reversal.
writes: New local artifact directory only, refuses overwrite. Source/card/findings/register edits in scope, no commit/push/live changes.
